summary: Banco Santander-Chile, a Chilean commercial bank listed on the NYSE, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim consolidated financial statements and a management commentary for the period ended June 30, 2026, accompanied by an independent auditor's review report dated July 28, 2026, including Notes 01 through 14 and disclosures of significant events. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor mandate is stated. This is an ordinary periodic foreign-private-issuer earnings filing under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation; watch only for disclosed material contingencies in Note 05.
